notes: Membership counts and leadership are not recorded: no roster source was read. The lecture names Leonid Kuzmichev as the head of the Tunka facility.

summary.plain: A Russian-Italian-Mongolian collaboration that runs the Tunka valley cosmic-ray and gamma-ray detectors.
summary.technical: Authors of the 2022 TAIGA overview come from 13 institutions in Russia, Italy and Mongolia, among them Irkutsk State University, MEPhI, the Skobeltsyn Institute of Nuclear Physics (MSU), JINR Dubna, the University of Turin and INFN, the Budker Institute and the Mongolian Academy of Sciences.
